# watchpoint_sgl_alert_rule (Resource)

An SGL alert rule that periodically evaluates an SGL query and alerts when the result crosses a threshold.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_sgl_alert_rule" "example" {
  name             = "Error spike"
  sgl_query        = "logs | where severity_number >= 17 | summarize error_count=count()"
  operator         = "gt"
  threshold        = 100
  severity         = "Critical"
  interval_seconds = 300
  alert_profile_id = "ap_001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable rule name.
- `severity` (String) Severity raised on a breach. One of `Success`, `Warning`, `Critical`, `Error`, `Timeout`.
- `sgl_query` (String) The SGL query to evaluate. Required.
- `threshold` (Number) Threshold the query result is compared against.

### Optional

- `alert_profile_id` (String) Alert profile used to dispatch notifications. Omit for status-only tracking.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Evaluation interval in seconds (clamped server-side to 60-86400). Defaults to `300`.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `operator` (String) Comparison operator applied to the query result against `threshold` (e.g. `gt`, `lt`, `gte`, `lte`, `eq`). Defaults to `gt`.
- `owner_group_id` (String) User group (`watchpoint_user_group`) that owns this rule. A filter label only; it grants no access.
- `time_range` (String) Lookback window for the query (e.g. `1h`, `24h`). Defaults to `1h`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) SGL alert rule ID.
- `last_evaluated_at` (String) Timestamp the rule was last evaluated (RFC 3339).
- `last_result_status` (String) Most recent evaluation status.
- `last_result_value` (Number) Most recent query result value.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_sgl_alert_rule.example sgl_001
```
